description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers structural orientation in a workspace repository: the dependency graph between workspaces, the task runner's own task list, and which workspace owns a path. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbors: authoring a component (the UI lane routes on state.stack.scope_root, not on this skill), a cross-workspace edit's impact set (blast-radius-analyzer § Monorepo), an unresolved workspace import (workspace-link), single-repo dependency questions, and coding-standards questions (standards-from-config).
